payload.notes: Fixup for the rejection in reviewer-to-coder.json: embeddingDimensionMismatchError (backend/src/errors/ragErrors.ts) no longer takes expectedDimension/actualDimension or puts anything in AppError's `details` — matches embeddingFailedError's existing ADR-5/ADR-13 pattern, doc comment updated accordingly. The dimension values are now logged server-side only, at the one call site (assertDimension in backend/src/services/vectorIndex.service.ts) via logger.error before throwing, same pattern voyageEmbeddingClient.ts already uses around embeddingFailedError(). Both call sites in vectorIndex.service.ts pick up the new no-arg factory signature automatically (they already just called `throw embeddingDimensionMismatchError(...)` through assertDimension). No other changes — everything else in PR #21/#22 was already reviewed clean. Commit 62f258a pushed to the existing sprint/3/e3-t02-vector-index-search branch (PR #22), no new PR opened. Full suite (119 tests) green and typecheck clean on the branch tip after the fix.
